slides.0.title: Level 2 Assessment
slides.0.subtitle: Regions, regulation and style
slides.1.title: Level 2 review
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Regulation
slides.1.highlights.0.content: PDO 100% / PGI at least 85%; OPAP = dry (red band) / OPE = sweet and fortified (blue band); Retsina is a Traditional term; Reserve is for former OPAP/OPE PDOs only
slides.1.highlights.1.title: The north
slides.1.highlights.1.content: Naoussa/Amyndeo/Goumenissa (Xinomavro), Slopes of Meliton, Rapsani/Messenikola/Anchialos, Zitsa (Debina)
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Peloponnese
slides.1.highlights.2.content: Nemea (100% Agiorgitiko), Mantineia (Moschofilero ≥85%), the Patras group, Monemvasia-Malvasia
slides.1.highlights.3.title: Islands
slides.1.highlights.3.content: Santorini, Paros, Lemnos, Samos, Rhodes, Crete's 7 PDOs, Cephalonia
slides.1.highlights.4.title: Sweet wines
slides.1.highlights.4.content: Three routes: drying, fortification, aromatic varieties
slides.1.content: After the assessment, continue to Level 3: Diploma refinement.
